description: A neutral starting point for any tracker that can show a name, a status and a stage per row (a board, a spreadsheet, an issue list). Copy it, rename it and adjust the field names and status values to match the tracker.
fetch: With the tracker's connector, list every row of the board, sheet or project at meta.tracker.target (follow pagination). Write a JSON list to a file with one object per row, keyed by this adapter's field names.
